facts.fact: The 2025 finance bill (PLF 2025, 10 December 2024), section 85 (Ministry of Digital Economy, Posts and Telecommunications), carries a domestically financed line of FCFA 1,400,000,000 for support to the regulator ARCEP, unchanged in the 2025 revised budget (collectif).

note: Only an allocated fact: the line is a transfer to the regulator inside the digital ministry's section, paid from domestic revenue; no earlier-year figure for this line is given, so no rose or fell, and no spent figure.
